title_as_printed: Methane gas solubility (Sm3/m3) in DF-2 formation brine (salinity = 32 g/L).
pressure_note: Equilibrium pressure of the vessel (brine + excess CH4 gas) set by a constant-rate/constant-pressure pump; total pressure, water vapour not separated; printed as round target values (5-90 MPa). Pump pressure relative expanded uncertainty about 1 % (k = 2).
layout: wide: one row per pressure, one solubility column per temperature (T printed in the column header under 'T (K)'); this mapping reads the 433.15 K column

value.what: Methane solubility in standard cubic metres of CH4 per cubic metre of formation brine (Sm3/m3). The standard (reference) T and P of the Sm3 and the state (T, P) of the brine volume are NOT stated. Measured by flashing the saturated solution into a gas collector at reduced pressure and high temperature and determining the CH4 volume by GC against a known volume of reference gas.

composition.other_species: Synthetic formation water 'DF-2' (Ying-Qiong Basin), composition given as ION contents in g/L of brine (Table 1, journal p. 3): Na+ + K+ printed as one combined value; HCO3- and CO3 2- are outside the six-ion set; total salinity printed 32 g/L. Authors: 'All formation brines are bicarbonate-bearing NaCl solutions.' Not convertible to a salt list without assumptions.

conversion_needs: Sm3/m3 to molality needs the standard reference state of the gas volume (not stated; 'S' could be 20 C or 15 C or 0 C at 1 atm) and the brine density / volume state (not stated).
g/L of ions to molality needs the brine density (not given) and an assignment of the combined Na+ + K+ value; density_rule nacl_25C_1atm does NOT apply (not an NaCl-only brine).
HCO3- and CO3 2- are outside the six-ion set.
notes: Each printed T column is a separate mapping over the same CSV (v2.2 option 4). All 10 pressure rows are data rows; no label rows. Values in 3b at 413.15 K, 10 MPa printed '1.7' (two significant decimals elsewhere); kept as printed.
